blocks.text: Genesis 38 interrupts Joseph’s story to follow Judah and Tamar. Judah’s sons Er and Onan die, and Tamar remains without the promised marriage to Shelah. Disguised, Tamar secures Judah’s signet, cord, and staff; when her pregnancy is exposed, she produces the pledge and Judah acknowledges that she is more righteous than he. Her twins Perez and Zerah are born, with the birth scene emphasizing the reversal of first appearance.
